what: Funding disclosure for every publication this repository generates. Research metadata standards expect funders to be declared; they do not distinguish 'unfunded' from 'not stated', and a blank field reads as the second. This states the first.
statement: No grant, institutional or commercial funding supports this work. It is unfunded independent research.
howToDeclare: Add entries to grants[] as { funder, name, identifier, award }. The Zenodo deposits and the paper's JSON-LD read this file, so declaring a grant once reaches every publication without editing any of them.
